connectorAttributes.SQL:
SELECT emp.employee_id                                              AS empid,
       emp.emp_number                                               AS employeenumber,
       emp.emp_firstname                                            AS firstname,
       emp.emp_lastname                                             AS lastname,
       emp.emp_middle_name                                          AS middlename,
       emp.emp_nick_name                                            AS nickname,
       emp.emp_work_email                                           AS email,
       job.job_title                                                AS title,
       loc.country_code                                             AS country,
       loc.city                                                     AS city,
       mgr.employee_id                                              AS manager,
       stat.name                                                    AS type,
       emp.emp_status                                               AS empstatus,
       emp.emp_other_id                                             AS otherid,
       emp.emp_zipcode                                              AS zipcode,
       emp.emp_hm_telephone                                         AS home_phone,
       emp.emp_mobile                                               AS mobile,
       emp.emp_work_telephone                                       AS telephone,
       concat(emp.emp_firstname, '.', emp.emp_lastname) AS username,
       dept.name                                                    AS department,
       IF(emp.termination_id, 'true', 'false')                      AS term,
       emp.joined_date                                              AS ftostart,
       termination_date                                             AS ftoend,
       contract.econ_extend_start_date                              AS contractStartDate,
       contract.econ_extend_end_date                                AS contractEndDate,
       cat.name                                                     AS category
FROM   hs_hr_employee AS emp
       LEFT OUTER JOIN hs_hr_emp_contract_extend AS contract
                    ON contract.emp_number = emp.emp_number
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ohrm_job_title AS job
                    ON emp.job_title_code = job.id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN (
           SELECT erep_sub_emp_number, MIN(erep_sup_emp_number) AS erep_sup_emp_number
           FROM hs_hr_emp_reportto
           GROUP BY erep_sub_emp_number
       ) AS empmgr ON emp.emp_number = empmgr.erep_sub_emp_number
       LEFT OUTER JOIN hs_hr_employee AS mgr
                    ON empmgr.erep_sup_emp_number = mgr.emp_number
       LEFT OUTER JOIN hs_hr_emp_locations AS emploc
                    ON emp.emp_number = emploc.emp_number
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ohrm_location AS loc
                    ON emploc.location_id = loc.id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ohrm_employment_status AS stat
                    ON emp.emp_status = stat.id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ohrm_subunit AS dept
                    ON emp.work_station = dept.id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ohrm_emp_termination AS term
                    ON term.id = emp.termination_id
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ohrm_job_category AS cat
                    ON emp.eeo_cat_code = cat.id
WHERE emp.employee_id != '0001';
